intro: Far Seer Mok'thardin seeks to harness the natural magic of Stranglethorn Vale for the benefit of the Horde. Building upon his previous rituals at Grom'gol Base Camp, he asks for sharp claws and a pristine feline fang to weave a powerful enchantment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The power of the jungle's magic must be realized and then harnessed by the Horde. My rituals have proven successful so far. I can cast very powerful enchantments. For you, brave adventurer, I shall make a special item indeed.
Bring to me some Shadowmaw Panther claws along with a Tigress fang. Not just any fang will do. It must be in pristine condition.
The beasts lurk throughout the jungle but you will find some close by, just across the river from Mizjah Ruins to the southeast.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your knowledge of the jungle is strong, friend. These specimens will be perfect. I will thank the spirits for sacrificing such fine beasts for the cause of the Horde.
